Classic banana bread

Ingredients: 3 ripe bananas, 80g melted butter, 150g sugar, 1 egg, 1 teaspoon vanilla, 1 teaspoon baking soda, a pinch of salt, 190g flour.

Preheat the oven to 175 degrees.
Mash the bananas in a bowl, then stir in the melted butter.
Mix in the sugar, egg and vanilla.
Sprinkle the baking soda and salt over the mixture and mix.
Add the flour and stir until just combined.
Pour into a greased loaf tin and bake for 55 minutes.
Let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing.
